entities.summary: Sarah Ruhl is an American playwright, poet, professor, and essayist. Among her most popular plays are Melancholy Play (2001) Eurydice (2003), The Clean House (2004), Dead Man's Cell Phone (2007), and In the Next Room  (2009). These works and others have been produced on and off Broadway and the West End.
